profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Cepheid
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 12+ years of experience building distributed systems and enterprise security platforms. Specialized in reusable PKI/TLS platform components, cloud-native microservice platforms, and AI-assisted development workflows, delivering 3× performance improvements and reducing implementation cycles by 40–60%.

[ Tech Stacks ]
Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular, C/C++, Python, SQL, Bash, Spring Boot, J2EE, ORM/Hibernate/JPA, Docker, Swarm, Kubernetes, Helm, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Redis, MySQL, Oracle, MongoDB, Jenkins, Git, Vault, Consul, AWS, LDAP, REST, MSA, PKI(x.509), PKCS, RFCs, Crypto Algorithm, RBAC, TCP/IP, HTTP/S, TLS.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led legacy-to-modern software migration and delivered new features and architectural improvements across 6+ projects spanning the full stack, while proactively resolving critical issues raised by other project teams. (Java, Spring, Angular, C++, AI agent, MS-SQL, REST, TLS, PKI, LDAP)
• Designed and implemented TLS communication and PKI signing/verification modules, added to the platform library and picked up as a standard by multiple software packages.
• Reduced implementation cycle time by 40-60% through adopting AI agent coding practices, and elevated code quality through a hybrid AI + human review process.
• Diagnosed critical product issues and drove PoC-based technical decisions adopted by management, directly improving business capabilities.
• Optimized software performance by 3x+ through systematic analysis of memory usage, GC behavior, thread bottlenecks, and query/data latency.
• Served as technical liaison across Platform, QA, Customer Support, Reliability, and DevOps teams, driving resolution of critical cross-functional issues and keeping projects on track.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led legacy-to-modern software migration and delivered new features and architectural improvements across 6+ projects spanning the full stack, while proactively resolving critical issues raised by other project teams.
• Built a scanner hardware emulator that gave developers and QA a shared automated testing base — now standard across multiple software packages.
• Served as technical liaison across Platform, QA, Customer Support, Reliability, and DevOps teams, driving resolution of critical cross-functional issues and keeping projects on track.

positions.title: Consultant / Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Improved functionality, performance, code quality across 20+ payment gateway and common services, delivering targeted bug fixes and enhancements. (Java, Vert.X, Spring, Redis, ZeroMQ, Kafka, REST API, XML, Vault, Consul)
• Decomposed 10+ monolithic payment gateway services into containerized microservices and deployed to Docker Swarm production environment. Led migration from Docker Swarm to Kubernetes at the end of the project.
• Mentored 3-5 junior and senior engineers, and partnered with distributed teams across Austin and India to ensure alignment on delivery and technical standards.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Mapo District, Seoul, South Korea · On-site
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented PKI-based Key Management Infrastructure (KMI) - recognized with the Korean Prime Minister’s Award for its national security impact. (Unix C/C++, Visual C++)
• Redesigned and launched an LDAP log management and monitoring system, delivering 10x+ performance improvement. (Java, Spring Boot, MongoDB, Redis, RabbitMQ, MariaDB, and AngularJS.)
• Led end-to-end development of a cryptocurrency price mobile service - from architecture design to production deployment. (Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Ionic, Jenkins, Docker, and AWS-S3/EC2/CloudFront/RDS/MQ.)
• Led the development of a TCP/IP packet monitoring and control system with a web-based management interface, giving operators real-time visibility into network traffic status. (Unix C/C++, Spring, Servlet, Applet, REST, JSON.)
• Architected and implemented a user access control and identity management solution, including a custom proxy server, encryption/decryption module, and data synchronization service.
